Data extraction: JSON top-level array emits Sequence nodes

```python title="Python"

def main() -> None:
    source = "[1, 2, 3]"
    config = {"data_extraction": True, "language": "json"}
    result = process(source, config)
    print(result.data)
    print((result.data.kind if result.data else None))
    print((result.data.children if result.data else None))

main()
```
